# ♿ UI and Accessibility Review

## Page/component
- Route/page:
- Reviewer:
- Date:

## Keyboard and semantics
- [ ] All controls have accessible names.
- [ ] Keyboard order is logical.
- [ ] Focus is visible.
- [ ] Dialogs/forms have correct labels and error associations.
- [ ] Status messages are announced appropriately.

## Visual and responsive
- [ ] Mobile layout checked.
- [ ] 200% zoom checked.
- [ ] Contrast measured.
- [ ] Content does not rely only on color.
- [ ] Images have useful alt text or decorative empty alt.

## Forms and feedback
- [ ] Validation errors identify fields.
- [ ] Required fields are clear.
- [ ] Loading/disabled states are announced.
- [ ] Error and success feedback is visible.

## Evidence
Browsers, viewport sizes, assistive technology, and findings.
